skills.name: Bullet Time
skills.description: Permanently increases Speed, Jump, and Max Speed.

skills.name: Fortune's Favor
skills.description: Chance to deal critical damage on attack.
skills.note: Invisible skill in the WZ (no name/description in the skillbook); included as-is.

skills.name: Shadow Heart
skills.description: Increases your Critical Rate and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Sommersault Kick
skills.description: A devastating kick that accompanies a backward somersault. Attacks all enemies in the vicinity. Cannot be used when equipped with a gun.

skills.name: Double Shot
skills.description: Fire consecutive shots that split on impact and explode on nearby enemies. Can only be used when equipped with a gun.

skills.name: Dash
skills.description:
Use by double-tapping, and then holding, Left or Right. Increases Speed, Jump, and Knockback Resistance for the dash's duration.
Not affected by buff duration increase effects. Can also be used in the air.
[Dash Activation: Right-Right or Left-Left]
Right-click to lock the command.

skills.name: Pirate Leap
skills.description: Use while in the middle of a jump to jump even farther. The higher the skill, the farther the jumping distance. Can also be used with the jump key.

skills.name: Knuckle Mastery
skills.description: Enhances Knuckle Mastery.

skills.name: HP Boost
skills.description: Improves your physique to permanently increase Max HP and resist knockback.

skills.name: Physical Training
skills.description: Permanently increases STR and DEX through sheer physical training.

skills.name: Dark Clarity
skills.description: Calms your heart to provide an increase to Attack Power.

skills.name: Perseverance
skills.description: Recovers HP and MP over time.

skills.name: Advanced Dash
skills.description:
Move rapidly by double-tapping, and then holding, Left or Right.
While moving rapidly, press the down arrow key to make a sudden stop.
Momentarily increases your Speed and Jump, although buff duration increase effects cannot extend that moment.
If you input this command when you cannot activate Advanced Dash, Dash will activate instead.
[Dash Activation: Right-Right or Left-Left]

skills.name: Sea Serpent
skills.description: Call upon the power of the Sea Serpent that lies sleeping below the waves.\nYour fighting skills periodically invoke the Sea Serpent's power to attack nearby enemies. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Sea Serpent Burst
skills.description: [Sea Serpent Skill] Attack the enemies in front of you with a Sea Serpent shockwave. Activates upon using fighting skills (excluding Octopunch) and isn't affected by cooldown reset effects.\nDoes not cost SP. Requires the Sea Serpent skill.

skills.name: Agile Knuckles
skills.description: Increases Attack Speed and Strength.

skills.name: Vortex Jump
skills.description: Allows you to double jump in mid-air.\nPress the Jump and the Up Arrow Key together while jumping to activate.

skills.name: Static Thumper
skills.description: [Fighting Skill] Attack multiple enemies with a shockwave when landing from a jump.

skills.name: Sea Serpent Burst
skills.description: [Sea Serpent Skill] Attack enemies in front of you with the Sea Serpent's shockwave.
skills.note: Invisible skill in the WZ (no name/description in the skillbook); included as-is.

skills.name: Skill 5101022
skills.note: Invisible skill in the WZ (no name/description in the skillbook); included as-is.

skills.name: Groggy Mastery
skills.description: Can recover quickly from being stunned. Critical Rate and Critical Damage increase when attacking enemies affected by abnormal statuses. Attacks also have a chance to stun targets.

skills.name: Admiral's Wings
skills.description: Focus on defensive maneuvers for a boost to defense.

skills.name: Precision Strikes
skills.description: Increases Critical Rate and critical damage. Additional Critical Rate against bosses. Permanently increases Attack Power.

skills.name: Greater Sea Serpent I
skills.description: Enhances your connection with the Sea Serpent's power, allowing you to conjure a more powerful shockwave. Activates upon using fighting skills (excluding Octopunch) and isn't affected by cooldown reset effects.

skills.name: Serpent Assault
skills.description: [Assault Skill]\nAttack a large area with twin serpent shockwaves. Unaffected by attack reflection.\nDoes not consume SP. Requires the Serpent Scale skill.

skills.name: Serpent Scale
skills.description: Harnessing the power of the Sea Serpent periodically creates Serpent Scales which can be consumed to activate more powerful Sea Serpent Skills.
skills.note: Invisible skill in the WZ (no name/description in the skillbook); included as-is.

skills.name: Turning Kick
skills.description: [Fighting Skill] Spin after jumping to kick multiple enemies in front. Has a chance to stun enemies.

skills.name: Roll of the Dice
skills.description: Test your luck! Roll dice to get a random Buff. Roll a 1 and you get nothing, but Roll of the Dice cooldown will be reduced.

skills.name: Corkscrew Blow
skills.description: Charge enemies and knock them back with an energized fist.\nThis skill can be used while using other skills and moving forward. Can be resisted by some enemies. Links with Octopunch. You can instantly approach the enemy in the direction Octopunch is linked to attack.

skills.name: Serpent Scale
skills.description:
Using Sea Serpent skills generates Sea Serpent Scales which can be consumed to use even more powerful abilities.
Each Sea Serpent Skill generates one Serpent Scale upon use.
Consume 5 Serpent Scales to enter Assault Mode, allowing you to harness more of the serpent's power. While in Assault Mode, your fighting skills trigger Assault skills instead of Sea Serpent skills. Assault Mode ends upon using 1 Assault skill. Assault Mode's duration is unaffected by buff duration extensions.
In Auto Mode, Serpent Scales are automatically consumed upon collecting 5 scales.
Auto Mode On/Off: Right-click

skills.name: Serpent Assault
skills.description: Attack in a wide area with twin serpent shockwaves.
skills.note: Invisible skill in the WZ (no name/description in the skillbook); included as-is.

skills.name: Greater Sea Serpent I
skills.description: Draws more fully on the Sea Serpent's power, allowing you to create a more powerful shockwaves.
skills.note: Invisible skill in the WZ (no name/description in the skillbook); included as-is.

skills.name: Defensive Stance
skills.description: When using the power of the sea serpent, temporarily reduce damage taken with the sea serpent's blessing.

skills.name: Double Down
skills.description: Try your luck! Roll two dice, and if both have the same number, you'll receive a very powerful buff.

skills.name: Typhoon Crush
skills.description: Ignores enemy's defense and increases Final Damage and Attack Power.

skills.name: Nautilus Strike
skills.note: Invisible skill in the WZ (no name/description in the skillbook); included as-is.

skills.name: Greater Sea Serpent II
skills.description: A deeper connection to the Sea Serpent's power enhances the power of your serpent shockwaves and unlocks new Sea Serpent skills.\nPermanently increases Final Damage.

skills.name: Sea Serpent's Rage
skills.description: [Sea Serpent Skill] Call upon the power of the Sea Serpent to bite and tear your enemies. Triggers upon using Octopunch. Enemies struck by Serpent's bite are marked with the Serpent's Mark, which increases their Damage Taken for a set period.\nNot affected by cooldown reset effects.\nDoes not consume SP. Requires the Greater Sea Serpent II skill.

skills.name: Raging Serpent Assault
skills.description: [Assault Skill]\nCall forth an enraged Sea Serpent by using Octopunch while in Assault Mode. Unaffected by attack reflection. Your increased mastery of Assault skills empowers your Serpent Assault.

skills.name: Aggressive Stance
skills.description: Take up an aggressive battle stance, causing successful attack skills to grant a buff that increases your damage. Permanently increases Corkscrew Blow's damage.

skills.name: Sea Serpent Burst II
skills.description: [Sea Serpent Skill] Enhances your connection with the Sea Serpent's power, allowing you to strike enemies with an even more powerful shockwave. Activates upon using fighting skills (excluding Octopunch) and isn't affected by cooldown reset effects.\nDoes not consume SP. Requires the Greater Sea Serpent II skill.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: The Goddess of Maple World's grace increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Maple World appear.

skills.name: Octopunch
skills.description: [Fighting Skill]: Pummel enemies in front.\nOnly activates Sea Serpent's Rage or Raging Serpent Assault.

skills.name: Hero's Will
skills.description: Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.\nCan be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Speed Infusion
skills.description: Uses HP and MP to temporarily increase the attack speed of a weapon. This can be combined with other accelerations, and everyone in the team will have their attack speed doubled.

skills.name: Time Leap
skills.description: Resets the cooldown of all the skills being used by all party members, including yourself.\nDoes not affect skills not affected by cooldown reset.\nTime leap is not affected by cooldown reset and party members that received the Time Leap's effect cannot receive it again for a set time.

skills.name: Nautilus Strike
skills.description: Order the Nautilus to attack multiple enemies at once. The Nautilus is unaffected by attack reflection. After learning this skill, direct skill attacks deal additional attacks.

skills.name: Crossbones
skills.description: Summons the soul of a proud sea serpent to temporarily increase Attack Power. Also increases Status Resistance, Elemental Resistance, Knuckle Mastery, and Final Damage as passive effects.

skills.name: Hook Bomber
skills.description: [Fighting Skill] Throws a punch that attacks the enemy in front with a powerful explosive energy.

skills.name: Double Down - Saving Grace
skills.description: Grants a chance to ignore the cooldown when Double Down does not activate. The next time, you will activate a Double Down with 4 or above.

skills.name: Double Down - Addition

skills.name: Double Down - Enhance

skills.name: Octopunch - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Octopunch damage.

skills.name: Octopunch - Boss Rush
skills.description: Increases damage when attacking Boss Monsters with Octopunch.

skills.name: Octopunch - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases Octopunch's attack count.

skills.name: Hook Bomber - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases damage of Hook Bomber.

skills.name: Hook Bomber - Spread
skills.description: Increases the max number of enemies hit by Hook Bomber.

skills.name: Hook Bomber - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases the number of attacks for Hook Bomber.

skills.name: Loaded Dice
skills.description: The next time you use Roll of the Dice, you get to throw an extra die and choose your desired number (via the number keys). Jobs without Roll of the Dice will be allowed to use the Roll of the Dice skill and choose their desired number.
skills.note: Shared pirate V skill (Loaded Dice).

skills.name: Lightning Form
skills.description: Receive the power of the seas and soar to new heights. Double-tap an arrow key to teleport in that direction. Use the skill again to attack nearby enemies with a huge orb of energy. The orb of energy is unaffected by attack reflection. You are invincible while creating the orb. When the command is locked, double-tapping the movement keys will not teleport you.\nRight-click to lock command

skills.name: Lord of the Deep
skills.description: Call upon the spirit of the dreaded sea serpent that slumbers beneath the savage tides to wrap yourself in a deadly barrier that maims all foes who venture near. Unaffected by attack reflection.\nCan attack a certain number of times when activated. Both the number of attacks and cooldown are automatically refreshed when cooldown ends while active. Using the skill again ends it immediately and reduces cooldown in proportion to the remaining number of hits.\nCan be toggled On/Off.
skills.note: Lord of the Deep.

skills.name: Overdrive
skills.description: Puts your weapon into overdrive to unleash more attack power. Afterwards, your weapon will be less effective for a short while and cannot be unequipped until it's back to normal.
skills.note: Shared pirate V skill (Overdrive).

skills.name: Serpent Vortex
skills.description:
Erupt with the force of the ocean as you charge forward.
Use an arrow key with the skill to charge in up to 6 different directions except for upwards and downwards.
While in Serpent Fury Mode, erupt all of your force of the ocean with one use.
Right-click to toggle Serpent Fury Mode On/Off
skills.note: Serpent Vortex (main entry).

skills.description: Strike with all the force of a raging leviathan. You invincible while striking after collecting force, and are immune to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses while casting the skill. Can strike immediately by using the skill again while collecting force.
